title: Distinct BLR query scope
statement: Let $x$ and $y$ be functions from an $n$-element index set to the field with two elements, and suppose neither is zero and they are unequal. The distinct-query scope is the injection from a three-element index set that sends its indices, in order, to $x$, $y$, and $x+y$.
hypotheses_covered: Two functions from an $n$-element index set to the field with two elements
